title: YSO 4th of july update auto teleport to fireworks

game.name: (💼 INTERACTIVE JOB) Young Street, Ontario Beta

features:
No ui
automatically teleports u from firework to firework (should be on foot)
theres a 10 sec delay between teleports
you need to manually hold e on each one of them
script:
--[[
  Script for Roblox Executor
  Teleports to each collectible position (models 1-50) with 10 sec delay.
]]

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- Locate the Collectibles folder
local events = workspace:FindFirstChild("EVENTS")
if not events then
    warn("EVENTS folder not found")
    return
end

local julyEvent = events:FindFirstChild("4th of July 2026")
if not julyEvent then
    warn("'4th of July 2026' not found in EVENTS")
    return
end

local collectibles = julyEvent:FindFirstChild("Collectibles")
if not collectibles then
    warn("Collectibles folder not found")
    return
end

-- Loop through numbered models 1 to 50
for i = 1, 50 do
    local model = collectibles:FindFirstChild(tostring(i))
    if model then
        -- Get the WorldPivot CFrame and extract the position
        local pivot = model:GetPivot()   -- same as model.WorldPivot
        if pivot then
            local position = pivot.Position
            print("Teleporting to model " .. i .. " at " .. tostring(position))
            
            -- Teleport the character
            rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
            
            -- Wait 10 seconds before next teleport
            task.wait(10)
        else
            warn("Model " .. i .. " has no WorldPivot")
        end
    else
        warn("Model " .. i .. " not found in Collectibles")
    end
end

print("All teleports completed!")
